title: Chartered Accountancy Foundation
tagline: Integrated coaching for the ICAI Foundation examination, taken alongside the intermediate programme.
overview: The CA Foundation is the entry level of the Chartered Accountancy qualification awarded by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Students may register after Class 10 and sit the examination once they have completed Class 12. Coaching runs alongside the intermediate timetable and covers all four papers, Accounting, Business Laws, Quantitative Aptitude, and Business Economics, so students can move on to CA Intermediate without losing a year.
highlights: Coverage of all four ICAI Foundation papers
Regular mock tests in the ICAI exam pattern
Guidance on ICAI registration and exam cycles
duration: Foundation coaching alongside 2 years of Intermediate
